hints.title: Target Subsequences
hints.text: Valid selections of length 3 with no adjacent identical buildings are either "010" or "101".

hints.title: Center Element Centric View
hints.text: For each character acting as the middle building of the triplet, count matching opposing characters before and after it.

hints.title: Multiplicative Contribution
hints.text: If s[i] == "1", it contributes (zeros_before * zeros_after). If s[i] == "0", it contributes (ones_before * ones_after).

hints.title: Linear Combinatorial Tally
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfWays(self, s: str) -> int:
        total0 = s.count("0")
        total1 = len(s) - total0
        c0 = 0
        c1 = 0
        ans = 0
        for ch in s:
            if ch == "0":
                ans += c1 * (total1 - c1)
                c0 += 1
            else:
                ans += c0 * (total0 - c0)
                c1 += 1
        return ans
```
